critical_code_review_comments: server.py:738-752 _is_admin_place_reject() checks class=='place' + type∈{city,state,country,county,municipality,administrative,province,region,town,village,suburb,neighbourhood} AND class∈{boundary} AND addresstype matching same set. Good defensive coverage.
server.py:911-912 try_nominatim() iterates results and skips admin-level entries via `continue` — correct short-circuit before assigning lat/lon.
server.py:794 geocode_photon() filters feats with list-comprehension `[f for f in feats if not _is_admin_place_reject(f.get('properties',{}))]` — clean and testable.

server.py:813-865 geocode_google_places() correctly uses httpx.AsyncClient + Text Search API with region/language/location/radius bias. Includes preferred_types picker for street_address/premise/route. Returns provider='google_places' + place_types for observability.
server.py:283-299 _extract_coords_from_text() enforces -34.0<=lat<=5.0 AND -74.0<=lon<=-34.0 which matches Brazilian mainland bounds. Also supports lon-first order via _COORD_PAIR_ALT_RE — good.

server.py:1087-1122 _resolve_cep_to_latlon() delegates to geocode_nominatim() which now uses the full 5-stage pipeline — so a CEP that resolves via ViaCEP to a logradouro/bairro/localidade string gets the best-available provider. Solid.

route.tsx:521-574 renderStopItem uses ScaleDecorator + separate drag handle (testID='drag-handle-{index}') with onPressIn={drag}. Long-press on the row also triggers drag (line 533). Two independent activation paths is good UX.

route.tsx:228-297 reoptimize() correctly picks firstFixed/lastFixed with swap on invert, filters middle by id!=first/last, calls optimizeRoute with start_lat/start_lon=firstFixed and return_to_start=false. Combines done+firstFixed+orderedMiddle+lastFixed with re-indexed ids — matches spec.

route.tsx:509-519 handleDragEnd preserves done-first ordering (done stops stay pinned at top), re-numbers ids after drag, and turns OFF Circuit lock — matches product requirement 'user manually reordered → allow optimization'.

upload.tsx:104-108 map spreads `...s` then explicitly re-nulls lat/lon with `s.lat ?? null, s.lon ?? null` — nullish coalescing preserves backend-provided coords AND normalizes undefined→null for storage. Correct.
